business_problem: The PvX team needed a way to ingest and normalize the data into a single model while staying aligned with strict compliance standards from the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS). The platform also had to scale to manage the compounding data volumes that come with new clients.
solution_summary: Powering 15,000+ cohort evaluations for PvX Partners and facilitating $1B+ in financing through PvX Capital by unifying core data assets in BigQuery. The PvX team needed a way to ingest and normalize the data into a single model while staying aligned with strict compliance standards from the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS). The platform also had to scale to manage the compounding data volumes that come with new clients. PvX found the combination of a scalable, queryable database, a secure production infrastructure, and a unified AI stack with Google Cloud. “Choosing a platform that could handle the data engineering, the warehousing, and the modeling in one place was effectively the first decision the company made,” the PvX Partners team shares.

solution_components.name: BigQuery
solution_components.role: Stores and queries the analytics and AI-ready datasets that power the workload.

solution_components.name: Cloud Run
solution_components.role: Runs serverless application services and APIs with automatic scaling for bursty workloads.

solution_components.name: Cloud SQL
solution_components.role: Stores transactional state and application data for the operational workflow at low latency.

solution_components.name: Managed Service for Apache Spark
solution_components.role: runs high-volume raw data import pipelines on provisioned clusters and also executes critical workloads in serverless mode when resilience matters most

solution_components.name: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
solution_components.role: Orchestrates the platform's containerized services and high-concurrency workloads.

solution_components.name: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
solution_components.role: Coordinates multi-agent workflows, tool calling, and governed automation across the application.
